custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the blue lace trim meets the main fabric body. AI generators often create 'floating' lace or blurred connections. Also, verify if the polka dots maintain consistent perspective and shape across the curved surface of the bib, and confirm that the yellow elements at the top are indeed functional ties attached to the neck curve.
image_description: A close-up view of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface. The bib features a curved neck opening and a rounded body shape. It is constructed with multiple layers or panels: a central white section, a pink panel with silver/white polka dots on the left, and blue ruffled lace trim along the edges. A yellow ribbon or tie is visible at the top center.
